ClipFarm x DIGGER Brief
CLIPFARM x DIGGER CAMPAIGN BRIEF
by Warner Bros. Pictures
REQUIRED DISCLOSURE: #DiggerPartner
End every caption with #DiggerPartner. Every post needs it.
APPROVED FOOTAGE: https://f.io/czxfG7a5
DIGGER is the new Tom Cruise movie from Warner Bros., in theaters now. Make clips that get
people curious enough to buy a ticket.
CPM MAX PER CLIP MIN PAYOUT
$1.50 / 1K $750 $1.50
READ THIS FIRST, DON'T SKIP
Use only the approved DIGGER footage from the Warner Bros. folder. Nothing else.
The framing, in your own words: people are split on DIGGER, so go see it and decide for
yourself.
Don't quote review scores or box office numbers, or argue with critics. Find the funny,
weird or surprising moment instead.
WB GUARDRAILS (REQUIRED)
● Don't reveal the twist. Hinting at twists and surprises is fine, but never say what the
twist is.
● Don't compare DIGGER to "Don't Look Up".
● Don't politicize the film. Keep it about the movie.
● Tom Cruise: keep it to his performance and praise for his past roles and films. Never
mention or hint at Scientology or his past relationships.
QUICK FACTS
Client Warner Bros. Pictures: DIGGER
Page type Any established page: movie and entertainment, meme and
comedy, pop culture, general clip pages. Use your existing page, no
new DIGGER-only accounts.
https://docs.google.com/document/u/0/d/14ywRNHuiztlnsu-VbD8ZL1NvQkqcrXYNOB_fwG6tthE/mobilebasic 10/27/26, 2:25 PM

Content Approved DIGGER footage only: trailers, TV spots, clips and
GIFs (link below)
Platforms TikTok · Instagram Reels · YouTube Shorts
Caption Write your own, then end with #DiggerPartner. Tag Warner
Bros. Keep it curious.
Audience 40%+ of views from the US
THE MOVIE AND THE GOAL
DIGGER is a dark comedy from Alejandro G. Iñárritu, the Oscar-winning director of Birdman and
The Revenant. Tom Cruise plays Digger Rockwell, an oil billionaire whose greed sets off a global
catastrophe. The President (John Goodman) then puts him in charge of digging everyone out of
the mess he made. Also starring Riz Ahmed, Sandra Hüller and Jesse Plemons.
The goal: reach people who aren't already talking about this movie and make them curious
enough to see it. Don't argue that it's good. Show them something they didn't expect, then let them
decide.
The framing (say it your way, no set line or end card needed):
People are split on this movie. Go see it and decide for yourself.
HOOKS THAT WORK
Warner Bros. wants unexpected, funny or provocative hooks that start a conversation. Grab
attention in the first 2 seconds. Some angles to start from:
1. "Wait, that's Tom Cruise?" He's barely recognizable as Digger. Lead with the look, then
reveal who it is.
2. The premise as a POV. "POV: the richest man alive caused the disaster and now wants
credit for fixing it."
3. No-context lines. Pull the strangest line from the footage, put it on screen, and let it
hang.
4. Cast spotting. John Goodman as the President, plus Riz Ahmed, Sandra Hüller and
Jesse Plemons. "Nobody told me this cast was in a comedy."
5. Love it or hate it. People are split on this movie, so lean into it: "Half the internet loves it,
half hates it. Which side are you on?" Let the comments argue.
6. Fan-edit energy. Fast cuts and the biggest moments, synced to the footage's own audio.
The client has been seeing fan edits pop off all week and wants more.
WHAT TO DO
1. Download footage from the approved DIGGER folder below.
2. Make a short vertical video using only that footage. Add your own hook, on-screen text
and captions.
3. Get the framing across: people are split on DIGGER, so go see it and decide for
yourself, in your own words.
4. Post it, then submit on Whop and open a ticket in Whop or Discord once your analytics
have loaded. This is for approval.
Not sure how to submit? See the "How To Submit Clips" section.
https://docs.google.com/document/u/0/d/14ywRNHuiztlnsu-VbD8ZL1NvQkqcrXYNOB_fwG6tthE/mobilebasic 10/27/26, 2:25 PM
Page 2 of 4
WHERE TO GET THE FOOTAGE
● Approved DIGGER folder: https://f.io/czxfG7a5
● Trailers, TV spots and clips (about 15 minutes in total), plus short GIFs. Use only this
folder.
● No outside footage: no cam rips, leaked scenes, other movies or old Tom Cruise clips.
● You can add your own voiceover or face-cam commentary over the approved footage.
FORMAT
● Vertical 9:16, 10 to 60 seconds.
● Hook in the first 2 seconds. On-screen text or captions throughout; most people watch
with the sound off.
● Use the footage's original audio or sounds cleared for commercial use. No added
copyrighted music.
● Brand-new edits only. No reposting someone else's clip.
WHERE TO POST
1. TikTok
2. Instagram Reels
3. YouTube Shorts
YOUR CAPTION (REQUIRED)
Write your own and end it with #DiggerPartner. Every post needs it. Keep it short and curious,
no spoilers. Tag Warner Bros. A question like "Seen it yet? Which side are you on?" gets people
commenting.
YOUR AUDIENCE (REQUIRED)
At least 40% of your views must come from the US. Submit a screen recording of your account
analytics showing the country breakdown. Clips under 40% US do not get paid.
HOW TO SUBMIT (REQUIRED)
1. Post your video with #DiggerPartner at the end of the caption.
2. Copy the post link.
3. Submit it on Whop.
4. Submit your account and video demographics when asked.
5. Wait for approval. Then you get paid.
THE RULES
